code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia with microcytic features, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with neutropenia, and elevated RDW and ferritin, suggesting possible chronic disease or inflammation. INR is elevated, indicating increased bleeding risk. Mild hypoalbuminemia and hypoproteinemia are present. Glucose is slightly low. No significant liver or renal dysfunction is evident. Findings are concerning for chronic illness, possible bone marrow suppression, and impaired oxygenation; clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
